provenance.focal_out_rule: largest equidistant focal that crops no field of view; the vertical axis binds because the sensor is 16:9 and the mapping is radial
provenance.limits: inherits the pinhole fit: RMS 2.94 px, fx/fy 1.028, no coverage of the frame's top third. Stability across bearing is fixed; ABSOLUTE scale is only as good as that fit. Do not quote a range better than a few percent.
provenance.measured: 2026-09-01, cv2.calibrateCamera over 26 ArUco grid-board views (2x3, 75 mm markers, ids 10-15) captured from this robot's own RTSP feed
provenance.validated_end_to_end: stack pose vs accurate pinhole pose over the same 26 views, bearings -51..+28 deg: range error mean +0.0% sd 0.2% worst 0.9%; bearing error mean +0.01 deg worst 0.18 deg
provenance.why_pinhole: cv2.fisheye.calibrate (equidistant, the shared stack's model) gave RMS 52.9 px on the same correspondences; pinhole+distortion gave 2.9. This lens is nearly rectilinear, not equidistant.
